rows.grounds: vocative address to the goddess; compound of deva-deva-īśī
fused form; parsed as tra-guṇyād-bheda-bhājanam, a vessel of distinction arising from the three gunas

items.question: What is the vessel of distinction arising from the three gunas in the mahācīna rite?
premises: There is a vessel of distinction.
items.inference: The three-guna vessel marks the rite's differentiated application.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic role of tragunyādbhedabhājanam remains unresolved.
The precise referent of tatraiva is not explicit in this fragment.
items.plain_english: There indeed, O goddess of gods, is the vessel of distinction from the three gunas.
